gaps.placed: A lot is placed when its owner is >= 0 or its building is != 0; it is natural when its owner is < 0 and its building is 0. Natural lots always carry building 0 (lot_try_create), so a placed lot in a fixture with no mission (owner -1, as test_VG_E_e1e.py's world_factory(n_regions=1)) is still placed and is never cleared. The UNDECIDED comment at the site is replaced by this sentence with the ruling date.
